Report Description" CNUE-NEEC" CALLER REPORTS THAT A STOLEN MERCEDES SUV WENT INTO THE DETROIT RIVER LAST NIGHT. IT WAS DISCOVERED AT ~ 0930 HRS THIS MORNING. CALLER STATES THAT THEY ARE TRYING TO RECOVER THE VEHICLE. THEY ARE WAITING ON A DIVER TO ARRIVE. CALLER CONFIRMS THAT IT IS LEAKING DIESEL AND SOME OIL. THE SHEEN IS ~ 20 M2 AND IS LIGHT. THE SHEEN IS CONTAINED WITHIN THE SLIP AT THE PORT AUTHORITY SLIP. THE WINDS ARE PREVENTING THE SHEEN TO MIGRATE INTO THE RIVER. CALLER BELIEVES THAT IT WILL EVAPORATE VERY SOON. CALLER BELIEVES THAT IT WILL LOSE MORE DIESEL WHEN THE VEHICLE COMES TO SURFACE. CALLER CONFIRMS THAT PLACING PADS ON THE SHEEN WILL NOT BE EFFECTIVE DUE TO HIGH WINDS. SAC TO BE UPDATED UPON REMOVAL.

properties.summary: Incident Type: VESSEL - NRC Report ID: 982632 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party:
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 982632
Incident Time: 2011-07-12 14:00:00
Nearest City: Colon, XX
Incident Type: VESSEL
Material: OTHER OIL (OILY WATER)
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party:
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 44 gallons
INCIDENT OCCURRED WHILE USCGC DALLAS WAS OP TESTING A NEW OIL CONTENT METER. THE METER FAILED TO READ THE CORRECT PPM OF OILY WATER, OPENING THE OVERBOARD VALVE PREMATURELY WITH GREATER THEN 15 PPM OIL TO WATER RATIO. CUTTER HAD A WATCH STANDER IN PLACE LOOKING AT THE OVERBOARD VALVE TO VISUALLY ENSURE NO OIL WAS GOING OVER DUE TO FIRST OPERATIONAL TEST OF METER. ONCE WATCH STANDER NOTICED A SMALL SHEEN, THE OWS WAS SECURED AND SMALL INTERMITTENT AMOUNTS OF RESIDUAL OIL WERE NOTICED BETWEEN GPS POINTS 09 35.64N;080 54.78W AND 09 36.9N;079 59.0W. OWS WAS IN OPERATION FOR LESS THAN 1 MINUTE ALLOWING A MAXIMUM OF 44 GALLONS OF WATER AND FUEL OIL MIX TO GO OVERBOARD. SHEEN APPEARED TO DISSIPATE QUICKLY.

SkyTruth Analysis

Report Description
THE CALLER IS REPORTING A PROPERTY THAT IS OWNED BY THE TOWN OF BENNINGTON AND WAS CONTAMINATED BY THE BENNINGTON FIRE DEPARTMENT UP TO THE EARLY 1980"S. IT WAS CONTAMINATED BEFORE THAT AND TO DATE BY THE GENERAL PUBLIC. THE FIRE DEPARTMENT DEPOSITED AND BURNED CHEMICAL AND SOLID WASTE AND EXTINGUISHED THOSE FIRES. THERE WAS AN ORIGINAL CHEMICAL AND SOLID RELEASE AND SECONDARY RELEASES INTO THE GROUND, AIR AND WATER. THIS PROPERTY ABUTS A MAJOR RIVER THE ROARING BRANCH. THE GENERAL PUBLIC DEPOSITED CHEMICAL AND SOLID WASTE AND CONTINUE TO DO SO. THE CALLERS FAMILY HAS LIVED NEXT TO THIS PROPERTY SINCE THE EARLY 1970"S AND WITNESSED THIS FIRST HAND. THERE ARE OTHERS WHO ALSO KNOW ABOUT THESE ACTIVITIES INCLUDING MEMBERS OF THE AREA FIRE DEPARTMENTS AND EMPLOYEES OF THE TOWN OF BENNINGTON. THERE HAVE BEEN REPORTS OF THIS ACTIVITY IN THE LOCAL NEWS PAPERS. THE CALLER HAS REPORTED ALL OF THIS TO NUMEROUS AGENCIES AND INDIVIDUALS AND HAVE EITHER BEEN IGNORED, PASSED ON TO OTHER AGENCIES OR INDIVIDUALS OR BEEN TOLD THAT THE CALLER HAS NOT PROVIDED ENOUGH INFORMATION TO WARRANT AN INVESTIGATION. THE CALLERS MOTHER FIRST REPORTED THIS ACTIVITY IN THE EARLY 1980"S WHICH IS WHEN THE TOWN OF BENNINGTON CEASED THEIR PART OF THIS CONTAMINATION BUT CONTINUED TO ALLOW THE GENERAL PUBLIC TO CONTAMINATE IT. FOR A NUMBER OF YEARS THE CALLER WAS A POLICE OFFICER IN MULTIPLE DEPARTMENTS INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE BENNINGTON POLICE DEPARTMENT AND BENNINGTON COUNTY SHERIFF DEPARTMENT. THE CALLER TOOK THE OATH OF OFFICE AND WAS A SWORN OFFICER IN THOSE DEPARTMENTS. THE CALLER WILL SWEAR TO THESE ACCOUNTS AND HAVE PROVIDED THIS INFORMATION TO THE BEST OF HIS KNOWLEDGE.

THE CALLER HAS REPORTED ALL OF THIS TO NUMEROUS AGENCIES AND INDIVIDUALS AND HAVE EITHER BEEN IGNORED, PASSED ON TO OTHER AGENCIES OR INDIVIDUALS OR BEEN TOLD THAT THE CALLER HAS NOT PROVIDED ENOUGH INFORMATION TO WARRANT AN INVESTIGATION. THE CALLERS MOTHER FIRST REPORTED THIS ACTIVITY IN THE EARLY 1980"S WHICH IS WHEN THE TOWN OF BENNINGTON CEASED THEIR PART OF THIS CONTAMINATION BUT CONTINUED TO ALLOW THE GENERAL PUBLIC TO CONTAMINATE IT. FOR A NUMBER OF YEARS THE CALLER WAS A POLICE OFFICER IN MULTIPLE DEPARTMENTS INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE BENNINGTON POLICE DEPARTMENT AND BENNINGTON COUNTY SHERIFF DEPARTMENT. THE CALLER TOOK THE OATH OF OFFICE AND WAS A SWORN OFFICER IN THOSE DEPARTMENTS. THE CALLER WILL SWEAR TO THESE ACCOUNTS AND HAVE PROVIDED THIS INFORMATION TO THE BEST OF HIS KNOWLEDGE.
